stories.title: Aaron Glenn: Disappointed in myself, but totally believe we're on the right track
stories.summary: The Jets fell to 2-5 on Sunday by losing 28-25 at home to a previously winless Dolphins team that took a 21-7 halftime lead and then held on in the second half of the game.
stories.detail: The Jets fell to 2-5 on Sunday by losing 28-25 at home to a previously winless Dolphins team that took a 21-7 halftime lead and then held on in the second half of the game. After the game, head coach Aaron Glenn said he was "disappointed in myself first and foremost" because of the way the defense failed to perform in the first half of the game. Glenn calls the plays on that side of the ball and nothing he did worked out until the Jets were trying to dig themselves out of a hole. They held the Dolphins at bay long enough to cut the lead to four points in the fourth quarter, but then gave up a 63-yard touchdown and failed to stop Miami on a late fourth down that sealed the win for the road team. Glenn pointed to that second half life as reason to believe that he has the Jets moving in the right direction. "I would say yes. The reason why I would say that is cause there’s no quit in these guys," Glenn said at his press conference. "I know what the record is, I do, but I know what I feel about these players and how hard these players play. Come out the second half, it was probably doom and gloom from everything outside of it. But inside this locker room, the guys were ready to go and…

stories.summary: The Chiefs are so far 3-0 in matchups Swift has attended this season, but the superstar rarely makes public appearances at road games.
stories.detail: Taylor Swift has been a fixture at Kansas City Chiefs home games since she began dating tight end Travis Kelce in 2023, but the pop superstar has been less likely to show up – at least publicly – at road games. That puts her status up in the air for the Chiefs biggest road test of the 2026 season so far. Undefeated Kansas City (5-0) will travel to Seattle (3-3) in Week 7 to face the defending Super Bowl champion Seahawks in a "Sunday Night Football" matchup. Seattle, which enters the prime-time showdown having lost three of their last four games, will hope to get their season back on track with a win over Kansas City. Will a matchup of recent NFL heavyweights be enough to draw Swift to the Pacific Northwest? Here's what we know: Is Taylor Swift at the Chiefs game today? Keeping with tradition, Taylor Swift has attended each of the Chiefs' home games so far this season, and she's had some famous faces by her side. We don't know yet if she'll make her first road game appearance of the season on Sunday, Oct. 25, when the Chiefs travel to Seattle for "SNF." This story will be updated when we know more. stories.title: Brock Purdy needs help. Winners and losers from 49ers' loss to Falcons
stories.summary: The 49ers perfect start to the season is over thanks to the Falcons. But at least Christian McCaffrey's injury doesn't appear to be serious.
stories.detail: ATLANTA – So much for a perfect season. The San Francisco 49ers coughed up four turnovers and fell from the ranks of the NFL’s undefeated team on Sunday, falling 29-20 to the Atlanta Falcons . Six days after surviving a furious rally by the Commanders on Monday night, the injury-ravaged 49ers (6-1) lost star running back Christian McCaffrey for much of the first half due to a thigh injury and couldn’t hang on to an early 11-point lead. Atlanta (3-4) stormed back after McCaffrey’s fill-in, Kaelon Black, fumbled away a scoring opportunity in the third quarter. Rookie linebacker Kendal Daniels had a huge role in finishing off the 49ers, collecting an interception and fumble recovery in the fourth quarter. Winners and losers: WINNERS Kendal Daniels A week after being strapped to a stretcher and carted off the field in a scary scene , then taken to nearby Grady Hospital for a neck injury, the rookie linebacker was the first Falcons player announced to the crowd for pre-game introductions. Fitting. stories.title: Sixers overrule Embiid, sit center with plantar fasciitis management
stories.summary: Despite publicly calling to play Sunday against the Pistons, the 76ers decided to sit Joel Embiid due to right foot plantar fasciitis management.
stories.detail: PHILADELPHIA -- A day after Philadelphia 76ers center Joel Embiid asked reporters to campaign for him to play in Sunday's game against Detroit -- the second of the Sixers' first back-to-back this season -- the 76ers ruled out Embiid for Sunday night's game against the Detroit Pistons with right foot plantar fasciitis management. ​ "I actually want to play tomorrow, so can you guys put pressure on them," Embiid said with a smile after Saturday's win over the Milwaukee Bucks . "... I want to play tomorrow, so start writing articles and put pressure on them so they'll let me play." The Sixers decided against Embiid's wishes, as they look to keep the former MVP healthy for a long season. Embiid, plagued by various injuries, has averaged just 49 games per season over his 10 years. In their win over the Bucks on Saturday, Embiid had his tenth career triple-double, finishing with 28 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists. Having him sidelined is a significant blow to the Sixers' already thin frontcourt. Philadelphia also ruled out big men Dominick Barlow (back), Jabari Walker (knee) and Tacko Fall (quad). Walker injured his left knee in Saturday's win, exiting the game in the third quarter. …

stories.title: Joel Embiid posts triple-double as LeBron-less Sixers stay unbeaten
stories.summary: Joel Embiid had a triple-double with LeBron James out, Jaylen Brown scored 27 points, and the 76ers remained undefeated with a 127-116 win over the Bucks.
stories.detail: Joel Embiid had a triple-double with LeBron James out, Jaylen Brown scored 27 points on his 30th birthday, and the Philadelphia 76ers remained undefeated with a 127-116 win over the Milwaukee Bucks on Saturday night. James was ruled out with lower back pain management in the first of back-to-back games for the Sixers this weekend. He is expected to play Sunday night at home against the Detroit Pistons . Embiid had 28 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists and went 12-of-14 from the free throw line. Tyrese Maxey scored 26 points, and VJ Edgecombe had 17. Brown hit a 3-pointer off a pass from Embiid that made it 120-114 and gave the All-Star center the triple-double. Kentavious Caldwell-Pope sank a 3 off a turnover for a nine-point lead that sent fans to their feet and ended Milwaukee's late push for the win. Kyle Kuzma had 14 points and 12 rebounds for the winless Bucks (0-3). Jaime Jaquez Jr. led the Bucks with 21 points. The 41-year-old James averaged 15.5 points and 9.5 rebounds over his first two games with the Sixers.
